intro.summary: One of Calgary's oldest neighbourhoods, east of downtown along 9 Avenue SE, mixing early homes, new infills and condos near the Bow and Elbow rivers.
intro.body: Inglewood grew up along 9 Avenue SE, east of downtown where the Bow and Elbow rivers meet, and is one of Calgary's oldest neighbourhoods. The Inglewood Bird Sanctuary sits at its eastern edge. Its housing mixes early 1900s homes, newer infills and recent condo buildings near the main street.
